title: Respect that lasts only while help is needed
odia: କାମ ପଡ଼ିଲେ କାଜି, କାମ ଛାଡ଼ିଲେ ପାଜି
literal_meaning: When there is work to be done, a qazi; when the need is over, a scoundrel.
explanation: The paired words move abruptly from a title of authority to an insult. Read together, they expose respect that depends entirely on another person’s usefulness: someone is important while needed and dismissed afterward. The target of this reading is the speaker’s opportunism, not the integrity of qazis or any religious community.
meaning_odia: କାମ ପଡ଼ିଥିବା ବେଳେ ଯାହାକୁ କାଜି କହି ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଆଯାଉଥିଲା, କାମ ସରିଲେ ତାଙ୍କୁ ପାଜି କୁହାଯାଉଛି। ଦୁଇଟି ମିଳୁଥିବା ଶବ୍ଦରେ ଆଦରରୁ ଅପମାନକୁ ହଠାତ୍ ବଦଳିଯିବା ଧରାପଡ଼େ। ଦରକାର ବେଳେ ଆଦର କରି, ଦରକାର ସରିଲେ ମଣିଷଟିକୁ ଭୁଲିଯିବାର ସ୍ୱାର୍ଥପରତାକୁ ଏହି ପାଠରେ ଦେଖିହୁଏ। ଏହା କୌଣସି ଧର୍ମର ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଚରିତ୍ର ବିଷୟରେ ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: The paired words move abruptly from a title of authority to an insult.
odia_summary: କାମ ପଡ଼ିଥିବା ବେଳେ ଯାହାକୁ କାଜି କହି ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଆଯାଉଥିଲା, କାମ ସରିଲେ ତାଙ୍କୁ ପାଜି କୁହାଯାଉଛି।
usage_example: An organiser repeatedly praises a volunteer while asking for help, then refuses even to acknowledge that help once the event ends. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
cultural_context: The source defines qazi as a Muslim judge and explicitly labels the paired line ଢଗ; a separate lexical entry confirms ପାଜି is an insult. Institutional history in the old dictionary is not adopted as present-day law or status.
